About.subtitle: We are on a mission to democratize media editing. We believe everyone deserves access to fast, secure, and professional-grade tools without paying for expensive software.
About.storyP1: The internet is filled with media tools, but we noticed a persistent problem: they are either too expensive, overly complicated, or they compromise user privacy by forcing you to upload sensitive files to remote servers.
About.storyP2: We built ConvertAllNow to solve this. By leveraging modern web technologies like WebAssembly (Wasm) and client-side processing, we created a suite of tools that run directly in your web browser. This means your files stay on your device, processing is incredibly fast, and you don't need to install any heavy software.
About.whatDesc: ConvertAllNow offers over 20+ specialized tools. You can compress heavy videos, trim audio files, remove backgrounds from images with AI, merge PDF documents, and even download your favorite social media content—all from one unified dashboard.
About.promiseDesc: We promise to keep our core tools 100% free forever. We also promise to never compromise your privacy. If a tool requires server-side processing, we guarantee that your files are automatically deleted the moment processing is complete.
About.missionDesc: To empower creators, students, and professionals around the world with a reliable, safe, and lightning-fast digital toolkit. We are a dedicated team of independent developers (Fast Save Apps) passionate about making the web a more productive place.

PdfToDocx.howToTitle: How to convert PDF to Word?
PdfToDocx.step1Desc: Click the upload area or drag & drop your PDF document. Our secure server will receive it for processing.
PdfToDocx.step2Desc: Our advanced engine converts the PDF layout, text, tables, and images accurately into a Word structure.
PdfToDocx.step3Desc: Click the download button to save your fully editable Word document to your device.
